infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Renter Guardian uses the camera to capture photos of your rental for move-in documentation.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Renter Guardian needs microphone access when recording videos for your rental documentation.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Renter Guardian needs access to your photo library so you can add existing photos and videos to your property records.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Renter Guardian may save inspection reports and photos you choose to export.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Renter Guardian to access your photos and videos so you can document your rental.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Renter Guardian to use the camera to capture condition photos.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Renter Guardian to use the microphone when recording videos.
